policy: Current ordinary mono-color native rasters versus native uncalibrated source, using fixed clear-rail windows and frozen scan-only poses. Old fits are not accepted merely because they already exist. Known-pose validation is mandatory. Reserved cohorts remain reused development data. No new pigment or calibration status is adopted by this diagnostic.

notes: Green passes the regional median/contrast gates without a frame-pigment change, but that is not complete frame-color validation. Review absolute outliers and independent panel regions before certifying a default.
Blue fails absolute color and per-printing regression gates; its prior fit is retained until a replacement passes full validation.
Red color diagnostics are unranked because the frame normalization method fails two known scale/skew cases.
Do not attribute outliers to scan quality or finish without evidence. Fierce Empath appears nonfoil on visual review; investigate regional texture/printing differences.

visualReview.name: Return to Nature
